name: glue-orders

description.en: SHEAF S2b: a kitchen tablet's order taps taken offline (the kitchen ack and the four bumps CONFIRMED/PREPARING/READY/PICKED_UP, each decided on the tablet by the order machine) are sent as one tail of op lines; the venue's object rebases them in the order taken with its OWN deciders (command::kitchen_ack, command::advance with the shelf settled in the same turn). Every tap is merged or held (sent == merged + held); a held tap is a decision on the kitchen's strip (GET /api/staff/stock/decisions, kind held, did o-<ctx>-<oid>); the same tail sent twice is adopted once (the FSM is a DAG); a line with any key outside {op,oid,order,from,next,at} refuses the whole tail (422) and writes nothing.
description.uk: Офлайн-тапи кухонного планшета (бачив, чотири кроки) надсилаються одним хвостом; хаб перевиконує їх власними рішальниками; кожен тап або злитий, або утриманий як рішення для людини; повторний хвіст приймається один раз; чужий ключ у рядку відхиляє весь хвіст без запису.

producer.what: tablet().syncOrders(): POST /staff/orders/glue {location_id, ctx, tail} built by bw_tab_order_tail (crates/bebop-wasm/src/tablet.rs)

consumer.what: rebase_turn(): dowiz_hub::glue::orders::rebase with command::kitchen_ack::decide / command::advance::decide; hold_notes() for each held tap

readback.what: GET /api/staff/stock/decisions (the held taps), and GET /api/owner/orders (the order's status and kitchen.seen)

external_note: No external API on this path; an applied bump tells the customer through the venue's own push/SMS routing exactly as an online bump does (hubdo/routed.rs tell_orders).

auth.how: the owner's token (courier::staff_at accepts an owner token for Cap::Advance)

schema_status: drafted from the Rust types (services/operations/orders/glue.rs Body deny_unknown_fields, hubdo/glue_turn/orders.rs reply_json, dowiz_hub::glue::orders::KEYS); tighten from the first live answer
probe: tools/live-proof/probes/feature-glue-orders.mjs: place a TEST order; POST /api/staff/orders/glue with [ack, PENDING->CONFIRMED, CONFIRMED->PREPARING, READY->PICKED_UP (stale)]; the law holds, 3 merged + 1 held; the owner's order is PREPARING with kitchen.seen; the held tap is on /api/staff/stock/decisions; the same tail again applies 0 and notes 0; a tail with a phone key is 422 and moves nothing; the decision is closed and the TEST order ended.
